effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon can't be deleted in battle until your opponent's turn ends. If played by effects, it also gains ＜Blocker＞. (Rule) Trait: Has [Aquatic] Type.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may suspend it to prevent that deletion.)
